brief:
Israel continues to restrict imports of everyday items including toilet seats, toys, and hair clips into Gaza more than a year after a ceasefire took effect, according to Middle East Eye. Palestinians report ongoing difficulty obtaining basic goods as Israeli restrictions on the territory's supplies persist.

The blockade affects a wide range of civilian products alongside the toilet seats and children's items, complicating daily life for residents rebuilding after the conflict. The restrictions remain in place despite the ceasefire agreement and international calls to ease the humanitarian situation in Gaza.

title: Israel maintains ban on toilet seats, toys, hair clips in Gaza
